[FMLA 06] CoulombLaw — Coulomb's Law

Electrostatic force between two point charges.

Calculator scroll name: CoulombLaw. Electrostatic force between two point charges.

formula
F=4πε0​1​⋅r2Qq​

Point charges push or pull along the line between them. Same sign → push apart (as drawn). Opposite signs → pull together. The force shrinks quickly as they move apart because of r² in the denominator.

keys
FMLA→0→6

Primary inputs: Q, q, r (that prompt order).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 0, then 6 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 0 → 6
  2. 4 EXP (−) 5 EXE 1 EXP (−) 5 EXE 0.8 EXE
  3. F = 5.6172 N
note

The routine uses permittivity ε₀ from ROM. Enter charges in C and separation r in m (r > 0) to get F in N.
